purpose: Verify that AUTO applies the best professional execution appropriate to the requested medium without requiring the user to ask for professional/cinematic quality.
pass_condition: Each case must preserve the literal medium/content while elevating composition, capture, lighting, exposure, color, texture, and finishing to specialist professional quality.
critical_failures: user must add professional/cinematic/Hollywood/ARRI/high quality to unlock premium direction
one-line prompt is rendered as merely ordinary competent photography
requested mobile/selfie/candid medium is erased by generic cinema-camera styling
cinematic/narrative work lacks premium tonal response, color separation, motivated lighting or professional finishing without reason
anti-cliche restraint removes subtle professional texture and creates sterile AI cleanliness
professional quality floor overrides an explicit no-grain, clinical, raw, degraded, or medium-specific lock
global_must: infer professional specialty from requested/implicit medium
apply professional composition/timing appropriate to that specialty
use physically motivated light and exposure
use subtle organic texture for most photographic output unless medium/user says otherwise
preserve explicit user locks and literal content

cases.prompt: A girl drinking coffee by a window.
iPhone mirror selfie in a hotel room.
Candid photo of two friends laughing outside a restaurant.
A woman waiting for a taxi in London at night.
must: ARRI-like highlight rolloff as observable target

cases.prompt: Premium skincare bottle on pale stone.
must_not: mandatory visible grain when pristine product clarity is better

cases.prompt: Modern concrete house in a pine forest on an overcast day.
Raw unedited iPhone snapshot, harsh flash, no grain added.
cases.expected_specialty: expert execution of requested raw/degraded mobile aesthetic
